production.note: US model years. First: Acura says the '2021 Acura TLX Type S' would 'Arrive at Dealerships Mid-June' (20 May 2021). Last: Acura announced on 23 July 2025 that it 'will conclude production of the TLX performance sedan this month' (acura-us-tlx-production-to-conclude); Motor1 reports '2025 will be the final model year for the longstanding luxury sedan' (motor1-tlx-discontinued). No opened Acura page names the final model year in so many words.

body.note: Four-door sport sedan; the specifications list a '60/40 Split Fold-Down Rear Seatback'. No other body was offered.

configuration.note: 'Turbo Aluminum-alloy 6-Cylinder'; Acura's releases call it the '3.0-liter Type S Turbo V6'.

displacementL.note: 'Displacement (liters) ... 3.0'. No opened Acura page prints the cc figure; Acura's 22 June 2021 release gives a 'Fully square 86 mm bore and stroke' (acura-us-2021-tlx-type-s-arrives).

aspiration.note: 'Single twin-scroll turbocharger' with 'maximum boost of 15.1 psi'. The spec sheet lists the turbo as 'Twin-Scroll'.

fuel.note: Gasoline turbo V6 with EPA ratings of 19/25/21 mpg; no hybrid version.

drivetrain.note: 'Super Handling All-Wheel Drive (SH-AWD) with true torque vectoring' is standard; the spec sheet shows the Type S only in SH-AWD form.

transmission.note: '10-Speed Automatic Transmission'; the release calls it 'A specially-tuned 10-speed automatic transmission' that 'is standard'. No manual offered.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower @ rpm 272 @ 6500 << << << 355 @ 5500 <<" (355 in the TLX Type S columns). The May 2021 release adds that horsepower is 'SAE Net. Peak power arrives at 5,500 rpm.' Unchanged later: 2023 spec sheet '355 @ 5,500' (acura-us-2023-tlx-specs) and 2024 spec sheet '355 @ 5,500' (acura-us-2024-tlx-specs).

weightLb.note: TLX Type S, SH-AWD, 10-speed automatic (the only configuration), 2021 model. Quote: Curb Weight row, SH-AWD: "3927 | 3982 | 3990 | 4028 | 4221 | 4200", where 4,221 lb is the standard Type S and 4,200 lb the Type S with the optional Performance Wheel & Tire Package. Acura's 2023 sheet repeats '4,221' for the Type S and 4,200 for the Performance Wheel & Tire version (acura-us-2023-tlx-specs); the 2024 sheet gives the Type S as '4,221' (acura-us-2024-tlx-specs).
